editorial:
Imagine being stuck working for a scary boss who treats you like nothing. That is exactly where Atris finds himself. He is a small-time criminal in Berlin who is totally over working for the big boss, El Keitar. He wants to be the one in charge for once, but you cannot start a crime empire without a pile of cash. When his buddy Frank comes along with a deal that sounds way too good to be true, Atris jumps in headfirst. The whole vibe is a wild mix of street crime and dark humor that keeps you wondering how badly things are about to go wrong.

What really works here is how the movie balances the tension with funny, awkward moments. The acting feels real, and the way the plot spirals out of control is satisfying. While some parts of the story might feel a bit rushed, the ride is worth it. If you are into gritty crime stories with a twist, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the city details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends in a chaotic mess where the big plans fall apart. Atris realizes that trying to climb the criminal ladder is much harder than it looks. After a series of betrayals and violent clashes, the main characters face the consequences of their greedy choices. The final scenes show that the cycle of crime usually ends badly, leaving Atris far from the powerful boss he dreamed of becoming. It is a harsh reality check for everyone involved.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime comedies and stories about bad plans going wrong.
